messages:
maria: quick check — for the console preview of SLO alerts, are we comfortable exposing per-tenant error budgets by default? worried about noise and billing-facing teams seeing raw counts. screenshot (redacted): https://redwood.internal/s/preview-abc
aj: prefer opt-in. default should be aggregated service view, with an explicit 'expand per-tenant' toggle. keeps default noise low :thumbsup:
devon: toggle + RBAC is mandatory. also only show sampled traces when expanded. otherwise security will flag it.
liam: UX note — add quiet-window and soft-snooze controls next to that toggle. people will want to mute noisy tenants quickly.
sara: API question — current notify API includes tenant_id in payloads. if UI masks tenant, do we still emit tenant_id upstream (for routing/backfills) or mask everywhere?
maria: proposal: keep tenant_id in events (for routing/telemetry) but mask in UI unless user has 'tenant_view' permission. allows audit trail but reduces accidental exposure.
devon: small API tweak needed: add expose_metadata boolean on the alert payload so consumers can opt to hide PII-ish fields. minimal, backward compatible.
aj: example payload suggestion for /v1/alerts:```json
{
  "alert_id": "a-123",
  "slo_id": "slo-frontend-5m",
  "burn_rate": 8.2,
  "expose_metadata": false,
  "timestamp": "2026-03-20T10:12:00Z"
}
```
liam: rollout plan idea: default expose_metadata=false for self-serve orgs, true for enterprise orgs with admin claim. canary to 5 orgs first.
sara: telemetry: tag alerts created via the preview UI with "preview_ui" dimension so we can measure noise delta and false positives. also track "masked_view" metric for access requests.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout initiated for alert-api-change to 5 orgs at 2026-03-20T10:15:12Z :rocket:
maria: when masked, UI should still show aggregate error rate and burn % but replace tenant name with "masked tenant" and show a CTA 'request access' that opens a ticket (includes tenant_id in backend but not shown in UI).
devon: request-access flow should auto-populate tenant_id in the ticket with an obfuscated preview (e.g., t-XX34••) so reviewers know which tenant without full exposure.
aj: another nit: quota and threshold numbers in the console should use normalized units (errors per 1k requests or % of traffic) instead of raw counts — reduces confusion across tenants with different volumes.
sara: will update API docs and add a sample for normalized_quota units. link to PR draft: https://git.internal/r/redwood/alerts/pulls/1234 (WIP)
liam: soft-snooze default — 1h or 4h? my thinking: 4h for enterprise, 1h for self-serve to avoid prolonged blind spots.
maria: agreed: default 1h for self-serve, 4h for enterprise. make it editable in the quick-snooze dropdown.
devon: i'll sketch the UX for the masked view + request-access modal and drop in design channel. will include copy for permission rationale.
aj: checklist for next steps: devon -> UX mock; sara -> API PR + docs + telemetry dims; liam -> canary rollout plan + audit; maria -> runbook update for request-access workflow.
maria: thanks all — if no objections i'll file a tracking ticket and assign tasks tomorrow morning. :eyes: 
aj: +1
devon: looks good to me
liam: ok from infra side
sara: proceeding with PR, will tag you for review maria
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary healthy at 5 orgs, no regressions reported as of 2026-03-20T10:30:40Z
maria: great, closing loop here. we'll reconvene after telemetry shows noise delta (ETA 48h).
